P.T. Usha complains to IOA electoral officer over WhatsApp campaign for SOM polls
points: Usha objected to a WhatsApp message circulated through an account bearing Banerjee’s name, seeking support for the ‘New Bharat Panel’ and asking voters to elect four named candidates, along with their ballot serial numbers and roll numbers.
File | Photo Credit: The Hindu Indian Olympic Association (IOA) president P.T.

Usha has lodged a complaint with the Electoral Officer alleging that former archer Dola Banerjee violated the Model Code of Conduct by circulating a WhatsApp message soliciting votes for a panel of four candidates in Monday’s (November 9, 2026)…

In her complaint, Usha objected to a WhatsApp message circulated through an account bearing Banerjee’s name, seeking support for the ‘New Bharat Panel’ and asking voters to elect four named candidates, along with their ballot serial numbers and roll numbers.

Usha cited Clause 1.9 of the Model Code of Conduct, issued on October 30, 2026, which states that the promotion of a candidate shall exclude any form of publicity, including the use of new media or social networks.

items.title: Dividend alert: MRF, Cochin Shipyard, Talbros and others may reward shareholders this week - Check key dates, returns
points: Dividend alert: Shares of MRF, Cochin Shipyard, EAAA India and Talbros Automotive Components are likely to remain in focus in the coming week as these companies are scheduled to announce their second-quarter results for FY27.

As the corporate earnings season reached to its last leg, Nifty and Sensex are likely to remain volatile in the coming week after the market ended flat in Diwali’s Muhurat trading session on Sunday, November 8.
Nifty 50 failed to retain the 25,000 levels and ended 0.18% lower, whereas BSE Sensex closed 28.62 points lower.
MRF, Cochin Shipyard, Nile Limited, Talbros Automotive Components, and EAA India are scheduled to announce their Q2FY27 results next week.
MRF share price closed 1.11% higher at ₹1,26,699.85 per share on BSE on Sunday, November 8.
Shares of Cochin Shipyard closed 1.48% higher at ₹1238 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of ₹32,569.40 crore on Friday.
The company scrip closed Diwali Muhurat trading session with 2.07% gain at ₹386.45 per share.

items.title: Revanth celebrates Deepavali with Indiramma house beneficiary
points: Revanth Reddy and his Cabinet colleagues celebrate Deepavali with a Indiramma house beneficiaries in Kodangal constituency on November 8, 2026.

Revanth Reddy along with Ministers and MLA celebrated Deepavali with a beneficiary of the Indiramma housing scheme at Parsapur village in Kodangal mandal on Sunday (November 8, 2026), in an initiative aimed at highlighting the government’s flagship housing…

The Chief Minister inaugurated the newly constructed house of Goripalli Sumitra and Srinivas, presented new clothes to the family, and had a traditional Deepavali meal of fine rice at their residence.
Revanth Reddy and his Cabinet colleagues have lunch at the residence of a Indiramma house beneficiary in Kodangal constituency on November 8, 2026.
The latest figures announced by Housing Minister Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy recently revealed that around 2.21 lakh Indiramma houses had been completed across the State.
Revanth Reddy and his Cabinet colleagues present new clothes to a family of Indiramma house beneficiary in Kodangal constituency on November 8, 2026 as a part of Deepavali celebrations.
